gitpr.description: GitPR MCP Server — AI-powered PR automation: generate commit messages, review code, run linters, trace code origins with git blame, create structured issues, and generate PR descriptions. Run 'gitpr-mcp --list' for the complete tools catalog.

_tools.name: get_git_context
_tools.description: Get the current git branch, repository name, and remote origin URL.

_tools.name: analyze_diff
_tools.description: Get the current uncommitted git diff (includes both staged and unstaged changes).

_tools.name: list_unstaged_files
_tools.description: List uncommitted file changes categorized as new, modified, or deleted.

_tools.name: analyze_unstaged_diff
_tools.description: Get only the unstaged git diff (index vs working tree).

_tools.name: get_full_diff
_tools.description: Get the full diff of the current branch against origin/main. Runs git fetch first.

_tools.name: generate_commit_message
_tools.description: Generate a Conventional Commits commit message using AI.

_tools.name: review_code
_tools.description: Perform an AI code review on uncommitted local changes.

_tools.name: full_review
_tools.description: Perform a full AI code review comparing the branch against origin/main.

_tools.name: generate_pr_description
_tools.description: Generate a complete Pull Request description (title + body) using AI.

_tools.name: run_linter
_tools.description: Run the static local linter on the current git diff.

_tools.name: analyze_blame
_tools.description: Run AI-powered git blame analysis on a file region.

_tools.name: generate_issue
_tools.description: Generate a structured Issue from code context using AI.
